column1: # The commands CI ran before the gate executor (the `gates model` of ci.yml and app-gates at 11c365fc4, before CI-in-Rust WP-3):
# `job` rows are every command of a root job, `app` rows the commands an app contract adds to its legs. The executor's contracts must

# Two deliberate changes since then (WP-3 review): C119 joined the conformance list, and the setup-rust and sccache-stats actions' own lines are rows of the five jobs that now run it first (ui, e2e, tools, icons, eslint-preset). Since train 9: the setup-rust action settles the image's pinned toolchain and stable (Rust 1.100, chore/rust-1-100) and prints the cargo build-dir layout opt-out on Windows (fix/spotter-win-cmdline-1-100). The install itself became `./dev --install-toolchain` (locked, checked and repaired, after CI run 8060).
